purpose: Sidecar semantic-role classification for existing main/data/ontology/sulfur_terms.json nodes. It governs WHICH existing ontology term_ids may currently be used as concept_id targets by the new evidence/lexeme system. It creates NO new concepts and duplicates NO ontology identity; it only references existing term_ids. The legacy ontology is NOT mutated.
rule: Only nodes with role 'concept_eligible' may be targeted as concept_id by lexeme or evidence records. Existence of a term_id does NOT imply concept eligibility.

node_roles.note: S²⁻ class — concept; 'sulfide' is its EN lexeme (migration).
HS⁻ ion — concept (IUPAC-preferred name for the anion).
MoS₂ — concept; chain target for the first governed evidence.
German lexeme of the sulfide concept; not a concept target.
German lexeme of the disulfide concept; not a concept target.
German form: not in DWDS contemporary lexical sources, no Duden entry (Recovery-03); observed industry usage for HS- (LEX-DE-BISULFID-001, contextual). Brand name of this site; not a concept target.

EN form is POLYSEMOUS (Recovery-03 evidence): Merriam-Webster 'bisulfide' = 'disulfide' (1831); PubChem lists 'bisulfide' as a synonym of HS-. Lexemes LEX-EN-BISULFIDE-001 (-> disulfide) and -002 (-> hydrosulfide) carry the two senses. The node stays non-concept: it names a word, not one substance.
NaHS naming inherits the bisulfide/hydrosulfide ambiguity; concept identity pending.
